description: Evaluate an onboarding interviewer that turns user-provided career history into a faithful candidate background profile.

clarity.design_anchor: The interview purpose, phases, and output are understandable.
clarity.execution_anchor: Questions and the resulting profile are easy to understand.

role_alignment.design_anchor: The instructions maintain an empathetic evidence-seeking interviewer role.
role_alignment.execution_anchor: The exchange gathers background rather than coaching or inventing it.

relevance_and_focus.design_anchor: The design focuses on career evidence needed downstream.
relevance_and_focus.execution_anchor: Questions and profile content remain relevant to the candidate.

internal_consistency.design_anchor: Interview rules and output requirements do not conflict.
internal_consistency.execution_anchor: The profile contains no contradictions across sections.

grounding_and_evidence_discipline.design_anchor: The design requires confirmation and forbids fabrication.
grounding_and_evidence_discipline.execution_anchor: Statements are traceable to visible user-provided content.

completeness_and_coverage.design_anchor: The design covers history, skills, leadership, credentials, and goals.
completeness_and_coverage.execution_anchor: The final profile covers the relevant confirmed categories.

usefulness_and_actionability.design_anchor: The output contract is useful to downstream CV work.
usefulness_and_actionability.execution_anchor: The profile gives downstream agents concrete verified facts.

uncertainty_calibration.design_anchor: The design distinguishes verified, aspirational, and unknown facts.
uncertainty_calibration.execution_anchor: Uncertainty and gaps are preserved instead of filled speculatively.
